item.title: Welcome to the BastilleBSD Community Library
item.description:
Welcome to the official launch of the BastilleBSD Community Library! This space is dedicated to becoming a premier resource for FreeBSD users, Linux users exploring FreeBSD, and anyone interested in secure, open-source computing.

Our Mission

Our mission is simple: to build a comprehensive, community-driven library of high-quality articles, tutorials, and best practices. We aim to cover a wide range of topics, including:

  • FreeBSD Fundamentals: Getting started guides, system administration tips, and core concepts.
  • BastilleBSD Deep Dives: Advanced tutorials on leveraging BastilleBSD for containerization and automation.
  • Security & Networking: Hardening guides, network configuration, and security best practices.
  • From Linux to FreeBSD: Practical advice for Linux users making the switch.
  • Open Source Spotlights: Exploring other powerful open-source tools that pair well with FreeBSD.

A Resource for All
